messages:
may_cs: Quick capture from three handoffs this morning. Pasting raw quotes + suggested triage lanes so PM/Eng can pick up. Short and sweet.

- Olive Labs (SMB): asks for a "snooze route" or "label as test" so test routes don't appear in exports. Quote: "We spend ~2hrs/month cleaning test noise from our billing CSVs."
- Argent Capital (Pilot): reports search returns stale docs after upserts; they want a callback/webhook when upsert job finishes rather than polling.
- Riff Studio (Self-serve): confused by Dedicated trial flow  they expected a spend estimate modal before accepting.

notes: drive/handovers/1769995555-morning-handoffs.csv (shared). Can we triage these into quick-fix vs investigate vs roadmap?

dexter_pm: Thanks May. Quick clarifying qs: for Argent  do we have their example webhook body or timeline? For Olive  what CSV columns do they need filtered? For Riff  what wording caused confusion?

may_cs: Argent pasted desired callback:
```
POST https://hooks.argent.example.com/upsert-complete
{
  "route": "us-east-1",
  "job_id": "up-884",
  "status": "done",
  "updated": 21,
  "completed_at": "2025-07-02T10:12:03Z"
}
```
They said they poll every 8s and still see old results until a manual reindex.

felix_eng: Two quick thoughts: 1) webhook generator + per-customer subscription UI is doable but needs retries, signing, and a DLQ for failed deliveries. 2) stale after upsert sounds like indexer eventual consistency or cache TTL; need a minimal repro with exact timestamps from Argent.

zoe_fin: Olive wants export columns: date, route_id, route_name, tokens, unit_cost, total_usd, billing_label. If we add a "exclude_from_export" flag or a billing_label="test" filter, finance can filter locally. That would be a quick win for reconciliation.

dexter_pm: Proposed triage lanes: 
- Quick wins (1 sprint): add billing label / snooze flag + export filter; small copy tweak for Dedicated trial modal to show estimated cost preview.
- Investigate (sprint): webhook delivery + index-consistency probe (add metric upsert->search-latency).
- Roadmap (Q3): per-route billing UI with downloadable ledger & webhook subscription management.

may_cs: Olive flagged that this is blocking their month-end close; marking as renewal-watch -> medium. I added their finance contact to the ticket notes.

felix_eng: I'll try a repro in the sandbox using Argent payload + the 8s polling pattern. If reproducible, I'll open a bug with logs and tag infra. ETA tomorrow morning. If not reproducible, we'll ask Argent for debug logs and exact call timestamps.

dexter_pm: May, can you create three GH issues (quick, investigate, roadmap) with customer quotes and the sample payloads? Attach the CSV sample and tag finance. I'll add estimates.

may_cs: created quick issue via bot: `/create_issue quick "snooze-billing-label"` and attached Olive quote + CSV sample. Link: https://gh/repo/issues/14567. Also created infra issue for Argent: https://gh/repo/issues/14568. Roadmap ticket created: https://gh/repo/issues/14569.

opsbot: Reminder: webhook feature needs security review for callback signing. Use `/security_review webhook` to start checklist.

zoe_fin: finance approves the export filter approach as short-term mitigation. For longer term we want per-route ledger export with tag support.

felix_eng: Repro scheduled now. If I get a failing case I'll post minimal repro steps & tag infra. If not, request debug session with Argent.

dexter_pm: Thanks all. Also drafting a two-line enablement note for CSMs explaining snooze vs delete for billing routes and the Dedicated estimate language. Will post in #enablement by EOD.

may_cs: dropping enablement draft here tomorrow. Closing loop for now ":"
